Common reasons, no code seen yet:

1. New object/array/function literal each render (inline `{}`, `[]`, `() => {}`) — new reference, prop "same" by value, different by identity.
2. Parent re-render + child not wrapped in `React.memo`. Default: child always re-render when parent re-render, regardless of props.
3. Context value object recreated each render — same issue as #1, worse spread (every consumer re-render).

Fix combo:
- Wrap child: `React.memo(Child)`
- Stabilize props: `useMemo` for objects/arrays, `useCallback` for functions

Show component code — pin exact cause faster.
